sessions.title: INC37675140 — Covestro Emarsys OAuth2 migration root-cause follow-up
sessions.summary: Complete investigation of INC37675140 follow-up. Traced 2 callIDs through full Kibana pipeline and confirmed ingestion pipeline was fully healthy (errCode 0 all the way through stream-combiner, HEP, dispatcher). 299 failures were NOT ingestion failures but CX Flow action failures. Root cause: old WSSE CX flow and new OAuth2 CX flow ran concurrently for 73 minutes (07:10–08:23 UTC on 2026-10-06), flooding Emarsys token endpoint with 429 rate-limit errors. The concurrent flows disabled one flow and enabled the other without overlap prevention. 299 activity records are already stored in CDP. Remediation: audience activation against OAuth2 action. Prevention: disable old flow before enabling replacement.
sessions.outcome: Investigation complete, root cause identified, remediation path documented, draft answer ready
